name: blender-ply
description: CAD-exported PLY models in Blender via the MCP bridge: /blender-ply:view-ply (vertex colours + clip + 3/4 view + zoom to mouse after the import), /blender-ply:center-blender (centres the view on the model without rotating it), /blender-ply:center-ply (object origin = cursor = world origin on the selected vertex, also valid in the exported PLY), /blender-ply:snapshot-ply (clean PNG on a white background via viewport render) and /blender-ply:ply-colors (vertex-colour restore). Bundled Python scripts, run inside Blender; a PostToolUse hook that speaks up only when a PLY model is actually shown grey
